section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results examining body appreciation differences between sexual minority and heterosexual men, with sexual minority men showing significantly lower body appreciation (M = 3.29 vs. M = 3.55). Mediation analyses using bootstrapping with 10,000 samples tested whether perceived appearance pressures, appearance-ideal internalisation, and upward appearance-based social comparisons explained this relationship. Results indicated that athletic appearance-ideal internalisation partially mediated the relationship, while upward appearance-based social comparisons fully mediated it.
